blocks.caption: Applications of biostatistics
rows: Clinical trials and medical research
designs studies and analyses data to test the safety and effectiveness of new drugs, treatments and devices
Epidemiology
studies how diseases are distributed and spread, finds risk factors and judges preventive measures
Genetics and genomics
links genes and diseases, studies inheritance and variation; supports personalised medicine
Public health policy
analyses population health, finds vulnerable groups and gives evidence for policies
Environmental health
measures how pollution and toxins affect health and guides regulations
Bioinformatics
analyses huge genomic and proteomic datasets for drug discovery and diagnosis
Healthcare quality control
checks the accuracy of diagnostic tests, tracks patient outcomes and keeps procedures consistent
Health programmes
measures the impact of immunisation campaigns, health education and training
Controlling epidemics
tracks spread, estimates mortality and finds at-risk groups in real time
Barriers to care
uses surveys and service data to find and reduce gaps in access
Health risk assessment and demography
analyses births, deaths and disease trends so services and resources can be planned
